verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents an official `@browserbasehq/sdk` Node.js package for creating and controlling browser sessions. It also offers Stagehand, described as "the SDK for browser agents" with natural-language selectors and self-healing actions, plus SDK-based webhook management. That clearly covers building against official SDKs. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond Node/TypeScript (e.g. Python), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
